notes: REF-BM-02: no remote page fetch anywhere; title/description are manual, no preview image, favicon merely derived client-side from domain via google service, not collected on save. REF-BM-03: title/description are editable both at create and edit, but nothing is auto-collected so the auto-collect premise is unmet. REF-BM-04: url/title/description/tags editable, but no note field, so note editing missing. REF-BM-06: createBookmark always INSERTs; no duplicate-url detection or convergence to editing. REF-BM-10: tags input is a plain text field with no autocomplete of existing tags. REF-BM-12: search covers title/description/url/tags (LIKE) but there is no note field to search. REF-BM-14: search has no #tag syntax; LIKE on the term would not match the plain tags column. REF-BM-15/16: no boolean/parentheses/phrase parsing, plain substring LIKE only. REF-BM-17/18/19: no unread/read-later flag or view; only an out-of-scope 'favorite' flag exists. REF-BM-20/21: no multi-select or bulk actions. REF-BM-22: sort is hard-coded (favorite DESC, created_at DESC); no user-selectable sort key. REF-BM-23: no markdown note storage or rendering. REF-BM-24/25: no local HTML/PDF snapshot or Internet Archive support. REF-BM-26/27/28: no archived flag, no archive/delete distinction, no archive view. REF-BM-29: no bundle/saved-filter entity. REF-BM-30/31: no Netscape HTML import or export. REF-BM-32: no user settings for sort/displayed items/font size.
